DeterminationBasis: No existing T14 control establishes the structural invariant that every mandatory falsification test identifier is unique. Existing T14 lifecycle, lineage, identity and freeze controls do not test duplicate or colliding falsification-test identifiers. A dedicated uniqueness control is therefore required.

No existing T14 control establishes that all expected normative section headings are present in the candidate or final standard. Existing lifecycle and identity controls do not test normative-section structural completeness. A dedicated heading-completeness control is therefore required.
